1.name: §g§lSlash

§6Click Combo: §i§lLEFT

§7Your §nMain Attack§7. With technique, quickly carve

§nDaggers§7.

§nSunsassin§7 on§b Wynncord §#eb3dfe§7. Thanks to §nChris§7
for helping with balancing near the end!

and §bElden Ring §e§7. Can you find these references, as
well as others?

§c⚔ §7Total Damage: §f+130% §8(of your DPS, for the flamberge)

   §8(§c✹ §8Fire: 30%)

§e✧ §7Effect: §f30%§7 Slowness (§c⬤§7) to Enemies

   §8(§f❋ §8Air: 15%)
§3☀ §7Area of Effect: §f2 Blocks §7(Circle-Shaped)

§7The warhammers summoned by §nForgemaster§7

   §8(§c✹ §8Fire: 10%)

§3☀ §7Area of Effect: §f3 Blocks §7(Circle-Shaped)

§nGlide§7 becomes an extended mid-air dash.

§d⌛ §7Duration: §f10s

   §8(§e✦ §8Thunder: 100%)

64.name: §h§lTurning Tides

§7If cast immediately after getting hit, §nBlast§7

§c⚔ §7Total Damage: §f200% §8(of your DPS)
   §8(§6✣ §8Damage: 160%)
   §8(§b❉ §8Water: 40%)
§d⌛ §7Duration: §f3s

   §8(§b❉ §8Water: 1000%)

   §8(§e✦ §8Thunder: 200%)
   §8(§b❉ §8Water: 200%)

§2➼ §7Range: §f30+ Blocks

§7Activate abilities to charge
your §bUltimate Meter ⌛§7 to 100%.

66.name: §i§lFulmination
66.description:

§d⌛ §7Duration: §f15s
§3☀ §7Area of Effect: §f20 Blocks §7(Circle-Shaped)

§7Activate abilities to charge
your §bUltimate Meter ⌛§7 to 100%.

§c⚔ §7Total Damage: §f100% §8(of your DPS)
   §8(§6✣ §8Damage: 70%)
   §8(§e✦ §8Thunder: 30%)

72.name: §f§lSuperior Arsenal

damage of §nStomp§7, and now boost the range
of §nCleave§7.

§2➼ §7Range: §f+2 Blocks
